name: Checkpoint context pointers resolved by brief
aliases: context store pointer open item source resolved evidence brief
summary: Parses ten lowercase KIND:VALUE tokens inside existing open-item source and resolved evidence strings without changing checkpoint schema or bytes. Brief resolves loaded authorized project tasks, comments, references and capabilities with no new I/O: live means existence only; superseded marks retired/prior evidence; absent and inaccessible both unavailable without label or follow. Every unloaded kind, including file/room/item/commit/doc/archive, is uniformly unchecked. Labels are escaped before clipping120 and every pointer is trust:data. Bounds10/item and50/brief leave remaining tokens unresolved with counts. JSON/text/web display pointer metadata while carry/template writer data stays unchanged; prose remains legal and old writers can carry it.
